breaks.quote: a plan so big it never left the page
breaks.why: A made-up metaphor the reader has to decode, instead of an image from their own life or Melina's words.

breaks.quote: closes the case on her: if she just can’t, there is nothing left to try
breaks.why: A courtroom image (case, verdict, closes, opens again) sits in the same passage as the earlier page image, so the reader meets two image systems.
